errorModel: Equal-race weighted individual-poll errors; fixed Student-t4. Do not reduce dispersion merely because two pollsters are averaged.
currentPollWeight: One newest independent poll per pollster; weight 2^(-field age/21), with no fitted RV/LV preference.
limitations: The archived historical polls lack LV/RV and original publication clocks. Current population transport and selected shifts are judgment sensitivity, not measured effects or confidence bounds.
Registered-voter support is not likely-voter support. Independent pollsters may share systematic error and state forecasts share national shocks.

The error model already includes historical undecided resolution and future drift. Assigning all remaining current support to the opponent is a separate severe stress, not additional independent sampling noise.
A positive expected settlement estimate does not establish a profitable two-day price path or actual execution.
